scope: Corrected PF231401 carrier rod exterior: broader upper legs, narrower lower U and35mm authored out-of-plane return from two attributed related poses. All metrics, depth, cut/weld endpoints and installed fit remain estimates. One continuous exterior envelope; hidden interiors are not asserted.

source_pose_groups.crosland: One oblique rear pose, two exposure images
source_pose_groups.matriz: Distinct frontal pose with rubber dampers and central boot

observations: Separate frontal pose shows upper legs wider than lower U
Oblique rear pose shows depth return before folded carrier bar
Rod ends lie behind upper web in oblique view; weld section not visible enough to reproduce

authored_estimates.method: Original bounded controls from distinct front/oblique related-family photos; no calibrated3D measurement
authored_estimates.tangent_anchor_scope: Authored fit-check construction from1.5mm sheet/5mm rod, not an OEM dimension

rejected_predecessor: Planar parallel-leg wire-v1 is retained as superseded study
remaining: Folded carrier bar source and captive nut exemplar
Upper web/rod/bar physical fit and current RDC installation

rejected_gray_trial.reason: Interpolating centreline produced subtle lower-span waviness absent from the two source poses; normals/topology passing is not visual reception
rejected_gray_trial.correction: Clamped cubic B-spline within authored control hull, preserving end points and a truly straight lower middle span; same bounded controls/section
